description: Occitanie Pyrénées en Intelligence Géomatique: dams and flood defences datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Occitanie Pyrénées en Intelligence Géomatique. Coverage: Occitanie Pyrénées en Intelligence Géomatique. The listing groups 32 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about dams and flood defences; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: ref risque DigueTroncon; Réservoir utile sur 100 cm de sol. Formats seen: TIF. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
